metas.name: Premada Oorali
metas.description: Premada Oorali is a heartfelt love story set in picturesque villages in the 2020s. The film intertwines romance and family drama, exploring the relationships between a father and son, as well as a boy and girl, as they navigate through intriguing, yet relatable, relationship challenges.

metas.name: Don't Be Shy!
metas.description: Quintessential Mean Girl, Shyamili ‘Shy’ Das, finds herself suddenly relegated to Loser-ville when Mayank, her boyfriend of three years, suddenly dumps her. But Shy, all set to get her revenge, finds herself falling into friendship and compassion with someone unexpected… Mayank’s new girlfriend - Tara.

metas.name: Go Deep: The DeSean Jackson Story
metas.description: Built from an extraordinary archive - thousands of hours of raw home video footage shot across 35 years by DeSean's older brother Byron - this is an intimate, unfiltered portrait of a father and his two sons - their bond, their sacrifices, their conflicts, and their shared pursuit of a better life.

metas.name: The Whistler
metas.description: Reeling from their daughter's loss, Nicole and Sebastian come into possession of a secluded Venezuelan farm, unaware of the dark forces they're about to face.

metas.name: The Love Hypothesis
metas.description: Olive Smith, a biology PhD candidate, and Dr. Adam Carlsen, a hotshot professor and well-known tyrant, enter into a fake relationship, seeing each of their carefully calculated theories on love get thrown into chaos.

metas.name: Порив
metas.description: Alex is set to spend the summer in a seaside town. On the first day of his vacation, he feels lonely and bored, but he soon discovers that many new experiences await him.

metas.name: Vibe
metas.description: Two inseparable friends' ordinary, unassuming lives spiral into an unpredictable, high-energy adventure that pushes their survival instincts and friendship to the limit.

metas.name: You+Me - Against the World
metas.description: Alma Lancaster, 18, appears to lead a perfect life within a wealthy family who believes she is studying law. In secret, she pursues her true dream: filmmaking. On campus, she meets Vadim Arcadi, 20, a magnetic and solitary rebel with a troubled past. Forced to collaborate on a student film, they clash, grow closer and fall in love — despite themselves. But someone is watching them, determined to tear them apart and expose secrets that could destroy both Alma and Vadim.

metas.name: Cursed Waters
metas.description: Shipwrecked pirates fleeing the Navy wash ashore on a remote island, only to discover it's home to a bloodthirsty cult guarding secrets no one was meant to find. Now survival means escaping both the law and something far worse.

metas.name: Mahendragiri Vaaraahi
metas.description: Siddharth, an atheist and skeptic, is drawn into a mysterious journey surrounding the ancient Varahi temple at Mahendragiri. As he uncovers secrets connected to the sacred site, he is forced to confront forces beyond his understanding, challenging his beliefs and changing his perception of faith, destiny, and the supernatural.

metas.name: Norton Creek Massacre
metas.description: It's 1998. Deep in the pine forests outside a sleepy North Carolina town in Norton Creek, A loner has spent his whole life dreaming of being a killer. His only real friend is Dron, a towering, near silent, monstrous juggernaut. Together they cause destruction on locals, and a group of vampires passing by.

metas.name: Sardar 2
metas.description: When the mysterious Black Dagger threatens national security, Inspector Vijay embarks on his most dangerous mission yet. As the battle unfolds, the extraordinary origin of legendary spy Sardar is finally revealed, uncovering the sacrifices that forged a legend and the secrets that could shape the future.

metas.name: Drawn Together
metas.description: Marfil, daughter of a powerful Spanish businessman, sees her life in New York turned upside down when she is kidnapped and released without explanation. Her father hires Sebastian Moore as bodyguard and, forced to spend every minute together, an inevitable attraction ignites in a world where nothing is as it seems.

metas.name: Biff the Human Slayer
metas.description: A delusional vampire takes it upon himself to rid his town of violence. To do so, he teams up with a couple of freshly turned vampires, a stubborn christian struggling to adjust to his new truth, and a rook who is quick to adapt to hers.

metas.name: 26F Seeking Friend
metas.description: After posting on Reddit looking for a best friend, a lonely, socially awkward woman interviews a series of potential new friends.

metas.name: The Spirit Lock
metas.description: Desperate to save their possessed son, a fractured couple turns to a cursed Pagan device—unleashing a greater evil that threatens their sanity, their marriage, and their souls.

metas.name: Dark Hollow
metas.description: When a nightmarish monster emerges from the depths of an Appalachian coal mine, a young mother must hunt down the creature to protect her home and save her family.

metas.name: Ramba Oorvasi Menaka
metas.description: A man spends 15 years attempting to use a magical book to summon the celestial angels Ramba, Urvasi, and Menaka to earth, but Lord Indra blocks their descent until they finally arrive.

metas.name: The Runner
metas.description: Maia Marten, a brilliant London lawyer, has her life shattered by a single call on her morning run: her son has been taken. To get him back, she must keep running, obey every ruthless command, and trust no one-each second a test of how far a mother will go to save her child.

metas.name: Mirzapur: The Movie
metas.description: Akhandanand Tripathi sits on the throne of Mirzapur. Munna Tripathi is heir apparent. Rati Shankar Shukla is the rival from Jaunpur. And, Guddu and Bablu are the two brothers who came like a tornado and changed things irreversibly. And now comes a new claimant in town. Babban Babua, from the desert of Jaisalmer. A ruthless man who is power hungry.

metas.name: Mysterious Origins: The World's First Humans
metas.description: Newly discovered ancient superhighways hold secrets that could unlock the origins of humankind. From the icy mountains of Spain to the scorching deserts of Australia, humanity's past is hidden in plain sight - waiting for those brave enough to uncover it. Will we solve the mysteries of our ancient past before it is too late? Prepare to uncover the lost origins and connected cultures that will shock and surprise.

metas.name: Beyond Top Secret: The Era of Disclosure
metas.description: Dr. Steven Greer leads the charge toward ultimate disclosure. Bringing forward firsthand military whistle-blowers, the film exposes the decades-long institutional cover-up surrounding off-world technology and classified programs.

metas.name: Assassin Within
metas.description: A notorious assassin captured by an AI-controlled covert Agency, must navigate fractured versions of his identities to reach the system's hidden cores-and destroy it from within before his secrets are extracted.

metas.name: Lola Dust
metas.description: After attending an audition, an aspiring actress finds herself the subject of a deep fake campaign targeting the British Immigration minister. In her quest to expose the truth and find the perpetrators, she becomes the victim of identity theft and digital harassment which leads her to a world hidden in plain sight.

metas.name: Sweet Candy Peach
metas.description: Deep in the wilderness, two best friends must learn to forgive and depend on each other more than ever when they stir up a group of dangerous locals.

metas.name: Gaskins: The Hitchhiker Killer
metas.description: South Carolina serial killer Donald “Pee-Wee” Gaskins carried out a reign of terror marked by extreme brutality. He stabbed, shot, drowned, and poisoned victims from his own community as well as hitchhikers, often targeting the vulnerable. Beneath the rural land near his home, bodies lay hidden in shallow graves, concealing years of violence. His history of crime masked the depth of his cruelty—until authorities uncovered the truth, exposing the full horror of his murders.

metas.name: Barreda
metas.description: A fictionalized drama film based on one of the most shocking crimes in Argentina's history. In 1992, Ricardo Barreda was an unassuming dentist, brutally murdered his wife, mother-in-law, and two adult daughters in their family home. Branding himself as a victim, Ricardo Barreda ignited a media storm and fueled a national scandal.

metas.name: Shark Thrash
metas.description: A small and touristy beachside town is hit by a storm the size of which nobody could have predicted. A family who just arrived tries to escape, but gets stuck in the quickly rising waters. They try to figure a way out with the help of some locals, but any progress is shut down when the sharks make their way onto the flooded streets. The family and locals must now find a way to survive as the waters rise.

metas.name: The Last Sunrise
metas.description: Ry, a college student with a chronic illness, escapes to Mallorca for the summer with her mother, where she unexpectedly falls for a local and begins to embrace living in the moment. But as her condition worsens and long-hidden family secrets come to light, everything she has found before summer's end is threatened.

metas.name: Peter and the Goblin Arrow
metas.description: When a mighty Dwarven warrior falls victim to a goblin's poisoned arrow, his weakling son must embark on a perilous quest to gather three ingredients needed to save his father's life before dawn breaks and all hope is lost.

metas.name: Pickleballers
metas.description: After racking up $25,000 in fines due to her anger issues, a young woman enters a high-stakes pickleball tournament with her friends to win the cash prize, despite having no experience and facing a ruthless rival with a champion partner.

metas.name: Plan Bea
metas.description: Bea has always known she was born to perform. But when a pandemic shuts down her school's music program and bans singing altogether, even her boundless ambition hits a wall. Undeterred, she convinces her friends to form an underground show choir — and what starts as an act of rebellion slowly becomes something much bigger: a reminder that music isn't a privilege, it's a lifeline. Funny, heartfelt, and packed with original songs, Plan Bea is an Australian musical feature film that proves you can't stop joy.

metas.name: Desert Fiends 2
metas.description: A group of elite bounty hunters are on the trail to track down and kill The Desert Fiends. Meanwhile, a TikTok style influencer has come into town to have a meet up while the Desert Fiends are heading that way to eliminate that meet up.

metas.name: Crude Awakenings
metas.description: At a ruthless PR firm, an ambitious publicist takes on a notorious energy company at the promise of a promotion. As a mysterious sickness spreads throughout her firm, she must decide whether to sacrifice her morals in favour of corporate success.

metas.name: Eye for Eye
metas.description: After a young woman is murdered, her killer begins receiving cryptic messages signed "Eye for Eye" while his family members are being brutally murdered.

metas.name: A Mother's Secret
metas.description: When a body is found in the walls of her dream home during renovation, new mother, Kenzie Carter spirals into paranoia experiencing terrifying visions about her daughter, Anna. Kenzie’s worried but busy husband, Eric, suggests a nanny to help. Enter Genevieve, the mysterious nanny who bonds instantly with Anna. As Kenzie’s grip on reality fractures, the body is identified revealing dark history, a missing past, and a deadly secret that threatens everyone Kenzie loves.

metas.name: Ram and Leela
metas.description: A repeatedly unlucky man finally finds the woman of his dreams, only for an unexpected twist to challenge his understanding of love and commitment.

metas.name: Learning to Fly
metas.description: Aisha McAdams, a former competitive runner turned photographer, embarks on a journey to document the triumphs and struggles of famed ultra trailrunners, including Jim Walmsley and Eszter Csillag. Traveling to mythical races—the Western States Endurance Run in the mountains of eastern California, the Ultra-Trail du Mont-Blanc in the French Alps—the film marvels at athletes who maintain their intensity as they run 100 miles of mountain trails while climbing thousands of vertical feet.

metas.name: Lizzie Borden: The Case Reopened
metas.description: In 1892 New England, a young woman constrained by Victorian society becomes the prime suspect in the brutal axe murders of her father and stepmother, sparking America's first celebrity murder trial.  More than 130 years after Andrew and Abby Borden were brutally murdered, their case remains unsolved. Lizzie Borden was tried and acquitted, but the mystery never ended. Now, this documentary reopens the case, reconstructing the timeline and re-examining the evidence, testimonies and suspects to uncover a darker possibility: what if the murders were not the work of one person, but a secret shared by the entire family?

metas.name: Novak Djokovic: The Wolf in Winter
metas.description: He's conquered every title in tennis, including an Olympic gold. So why is Novak Djokovic still playing? The Wolf in Winter embeds with the greatest tennis player of all time as he returned to the Australian Open in 2025, capturing the obsession, the preparation, and the fire that won't go out even when there's nothing left to prove.

metas.name: He Loves Me Not
metas.description: An aspiring actress chosen as a wild card for a reality TV dating show uses a secret elixir to win the heart of the star, but when her deception is revealed, she discovers a messy but real chance for love.

metas.name: Back to the 90s
metas.description: When a mysterious glitch sends a rising boyband back to 1995 - just days before the biggest showcase of their lives - the five friends race to reverse the time slip. But as unexpected connections form and the past pulls them in deeper, getting home means confronting what they're willing to leave behind - and who they truly are to each other.

metas.name: Pallaburusu
metas.description: A 70 year old widower asks his son to buy him a toothbrush for his toothache. When the son fails to do this simple errand, their already strained father-son relationship becomes comically worse through a series of escalating events.

metas.name: Evel
metas.description: Trapped inside an autonomous electric vehicle on an isolated highway, a young woman must survive as a malevolent force systematically erases her digital footprint before delivering her to a ruthless billionaire predator.

metas.name: Magudam
metas.description: Peaceful medical representative and shipping harbor worker Linga's life changes because of betrayal and conflict in a coastal community.

metas.name: Awarapan 2
metas.description: Once a feared gangster, Shivam lives hidden away from his past, with no faith left in God or himself. But when fate pulls him into Bangkok's cartel war and forces him back into the darkness he swore never to return to, Shivam must choose what he is willing to live for, when there is nothing left to lose.

metas.name: All Night Wrong
metas.description: Gary and Ell (a married man with an inferiority complex, and a grieving young widow) meet on a blind date only to wind up stealing a killer's car along with a dead body and $40,000.

metas.name: Back to the Drawing Board
metas.description: In search of inspiration, a handsome young artist who is struggling to animate their cute dog decides to watch a VHS copy of the cherished animated series Fred and Frank. When the VCR blows up, something crazy happens, but you'll have to watch the movie to find out, you cheeky sod.

metas.name: The Random Guest
metas.description: A lonely wife who can't seem to get her busy husband's attention falls for a man who stays in the same guest house. What she doesn't realize is that he set out to be there not for her.

metas.name: The Hidden Order
metas.description: Across four worlds and centuries, ordinary people confront forces beyond their understanding as time, technology, fate and the supernatural reveal a hidden order governing reality.

metas.name: Deathwoods
metas.description: A weekend of camping intended to break Scott out of his post breakup depression, quickly turns  into a weekend of bloodshed, as his friends are picked off one by one by the urban legend that haunts the  woods surrounding the small town of Old Hickory, Tennessee.

metas.name: KJQ
metas.description: Two close friends become entangled in a high-stakes conflict driven by power, ego, and vengeance, exploring how circumstances shape human nature.

metas.name: Feed
metas.description: Five social media influencers spend a weekend at a forest retreat but inadvertently awaken and confront the world's first vampire.

metas.name: Taming the Mouth
metas.description: At the world's most dangerous river entrance, generations of mariners, engineers, and workers battle the raw force of the Columbia River Bar-and the monumental effort to tame it forever changed the American West.

metas.name: Where is Mr Right
metas.description: Successful event planner Bunmi longs for love and a family. Drawn into the seemingly perfect marriage of her neighbors, Bridget and Femi.When Bridget introduces her to her charming brother, Dexy, and draws her into a dark secret involving her husband, Bunmi is forced to confront the dangerous illusion of "perfect love," as she is caught in a web of deception where love, illusion and danger collide

metas.name: The Draft: Enemy To Go
metas.description: Jack lost his shot to hate. Will is his second chance. Together, they're not just playing hockey. They're fighting the system. The DRAFT - Enemy to Go.

metas.name: Black Burns Fast
metas.description: Black Burns Fast is a queer and quirky coming of age film set in at a prestigious boarding school in South Africa. 17-year-old adorkable Luthando is on track for a normal academic year, until Ayanda arrives at the school and forces her to rethink everything. In the aftermath, Luthando struggles with juggling multiple identities to avoid rejection from her mother and her schoolmates as she comes to terms with her sexuality.

metas.name: Srinivasa Mangapuram
metas.description: Vasu Babu and Manga are living in their own blissful world, until a ruthless threat targets their romance. As powerful enemies move to separate them, Vasu must fight for his woman.

metas.name: The Devil's Mouth
metas.description: A group of college friends' Thailand adventure turns deadly when they become trapped in submerged caves with a dangerous predator. As oxygen runs low, past conflicts emerge in their desperate fight for survival.

metas.name: Eclipse Across Europe
metas.description: On Wednesday, August 12, 2026, Europe will look to the skies for a once-in-a-lifetime event: a total solar eclipse. For the first time in 27 years, the moon’s shadow will sweep dramatically across Greenland, Iceland, and Spain, captivating an estimated 980 million viewers.  Traveling at an astonishing 1,500 mph and stretching 190 miles wide, this cosmic marvel promises to be the most talked-about natural event of the decade.  Our one-hour special delivers the ultimate front-row seat to this breathtaking phenomenon, packed with expert insights, cutting-edge visuals, and a countdown to the moment the world stands still.

metas.name: Due West
metas.description: A small-town woman in need of medical care in West Texas is forced to break the law.

metas.name: Echoes of Tomorrow
metas.description: In four thought-provoking sci-fi stories, people confront altered memories, forbidden love, artificial lifetimes and extraordinary powers. As time, identity and reality begin to shift, each must decide what truly makes a life worth living.

metas.name: Contention
metas.description: Siblings are taken hostage by a young girl with mysterious abilities. However, their captor is on the run from a cunning man who is hellbent on returning the girl to her prison.

metas.name: Supernatural Academy: Fate of the Dragon King
Thingy
metas.description: Desperate to avoid her ex at a secluded house party, a young woman finds an unexpected ally when a supernatural virus begins infecting the guests.

metas.name: Alien Storm
metas.description: A father, businessman and secret doomsday prepper escorts people to the safety of his bunker – actually an underground house – when a massive and potentially deadly fog descends and cuts the power at his home.

metas.name: Aurora Theater Shooting: Minute by Minute
metas.description: A minute-by-minute reconstruction of the 2012 Aurora theater attack, tracing the events of that night from the first moments of the shooting through the police response, investigation, and trial. The documentary examines the planning behind the attack, the questions surrounding James Holmes' mental state, and the lasting impact on the victims, their families, and the Aurora community.

metas.name: Capps Crossing: Wrong Side of Dead
metas.description: When a behavioral science major investigates murders at Capps Crossing, she finds herself trapped in a twisted web of lies surrounding the local ranger and his son.

metas.name: Borderline
metas.description: Convinced they are our secret saviors, rogue U.S. operatives abduct Mexican gang members and seed them across major American cities, unleashing criminal chaos, swaying voters by playing on nativist prejudices, and forcing law enforcement into a race to expose the plot as the escalating carnage threatens democracy itself.

metas.name: Oh..! Sukumari
metas.description: Follows an aspiring politician who falls in love with Sukumari, a beautiful and soft-natured woman, while her father conceals a secret that threatens their relationship.

metas.name: Sex and the Friend Group
metas.description: A shocking confession turns a close friend group upside down, forcing them to confront messy relationships, blurred boundaries, and the chaos that comes when sex, sexuality and friendship collide

metas.name: Redline Fury
metas.description: Street racers go against bad guy. Bad guy gets very angry. Bad guy gets back at good guys. Good guys win against bad guy. Movie has all the G's - Guts, Gears, Guns, and Girls. Good.

metas.name: Dread
metas.description: Terror takes many forms. In five chilling tales, the mundane becomes monstrous and no one gets out clean.

metas.name: Love Oh Love
metas.description: A couple is in love. One partner's excessive spending pushes the other into debt. When the burdened partner decides to seek a divorce, the other files a police complaint through the leader of a women's association. As they begin living together, they gradually understand each other's struggles. Eventually, they reconcile and choose to continue their life together.

metas.name: Cruel Love
metas.description: After falling in love with Ivan, a stranger who once helped her, Julia marries him, but his suspicious behavior soon threatens their happiness.

metas.name: Infiltrate
metas.description: In a city overrun by crime, government Agent Lily Chen is forced to choose between her duty and her family when her husband is kidnapped, and she’s blackmailed into assassinating high-level criminals to save him. As she delves deeper into the criminal underworld, Lily’s relentless pursuit of justice unravels a web of corruption, leading to a final, life-altering decision that will change her world forever.

metas.name: DRAGN
metas.description: During a team-building retreat in a remote forest, a group of colleagues unwittingly becomes the prey of a rogue AI-driven drone.

metas.name: Hungry
metas.description: A high school wrestling coach must overcome addictive behavior in ordere to lead his team to a championship.

metas.name: Chris Porter: Middle Rage
metas.description: In Chris Porter's newest stand- up special, he takes a hilarious look back at a simpler time.

metas.name: Christmas on the North Pole Express
metas.description: A woman named Cassidy rides a train to her small, home town, and explores her past, present, and future in different cars in the train.

metas.name: I Was a Teenage Sex Pistol
metas.description: Experience the Pistols' rise to global infamy with an honest, insightful account of a group of malcontents, determined to change the music business and to attack hypocrisy and stale conventions in society at large. Based off the novel written by Glen Matlock, one of the founding members of the Sex Pistols who co-wrote ten of twelve iconic songs on their only studio album, NEVER MIND THE BOLLOCKS. Glen describes in detail the mindset of the UK in the early 70's and divulges a mine of information; Steve's thievery, Wally Nightingale, the search for a singer, the exploding punk scene and a bleak backdrop providing a contrast to the excitement and energy of McLaren's shop. The public will now have a chance to hear the story, not just from a member of the band, but also from a man who had his contributions exceptionally downplayed.

metas.name: Nagabandham: The Secret Treasure
metas.description: A chosen warrior protects a mystical, serpent-bound Himalayan temple from those seeking to steal the power of the Brahma Kamalam, a divine relic.

metas.name: The Bay
metas.description: Best friends Emma and Lani, attending a destination wedding in Thailand, find themselves trapped on a sinking tour boat in the heart of a tiger shark sanctuary.

metas.name: Supernatural Academy: Birth of the Dragon Marked
metas.description: Privileged wolf shifter Jessa LeBron discovers she has a forbidden twin sister, Mischa, and that both carry the dangerous "Dragon Mark". As they reunite at the Supernatural Academy and uncover dark school secrets, they must figure out how to survive a world that fears them and prevent the revival of the Dragon King.

metas.name: Jinx
metas.description: Three years ago she stole a secret worth killing for. And now that she's back, this thief for hire has his own reasons for revenge. But just how far can he trust her?

metas.name: Eli Manning Presents: The Undercovers - Sabrina Ionescu
metas.description: Eli Manning recruits WNBA superstar Sabrina Ionescu to go undercover at her alma mater, the University of Oregon. Sabrina transforms into Jennifer Scone, an enthusiastic Ducks fan who's attending her first basketball game. She fools coaches, mingles with fans, and shocks the crowd at halftime.

metas.name: Unbreakable Me - The Gabrielle Daleman Story
metas.description: This inspiring documentary follows Gabrielle Daleman, two-time Canadian champion and 2018 Olympic gold medalist, as she battles injuries, illness, bullying, and mental health struggles. Beyond the medals and spotlight, she faces adversity with courage and grit, rising again and again to prove that her greatest strength isn't just on the ice - it's in her unbreakable spirit.

metas.name: Shattered Silence: Imitation of a Perfect Life
metas.description: Pastor Edmond Henry's appears to have the perfect life. But when a mysterious murder shatters the calm, his darkest secret is exposed, unleashing a chain of events that unintentionally destroy his family and everything he fought to protect.

metas.name: Space Coast Confidential
metas.description: A veteran detective is paired with a transplant detective from Massachusetts to investigate strange occurrences in Cocoa Beach.

metas.name: The Executor
metas.description: While patrolling a restricted zone, Agent MU-0213 is ordered to track down and execute a deserter. During a deadly confrontation, he discovers that his opponent is the fugitive agent MU-1225, known as Tristan. Cornered and seemingly doomed, MU-0213 is spared when Tristan asks him a single, unexpected question: "Do you have a name?" The question awakens fragmented memories, forcing MU-0213 to question everything he believes about himself. But what is Tristan really after, and why would a skilled sniper spare his enemy when he had the perfect chance to kill him?

metas.name: The Reality Experiment
metas.description: Eight strangers gather for an unknown experiment at the University for a quick payday. However, things rapidly get out of control as reality itself begins to turn on them.

metas.name: Heartin
metas.description: Fate tosses a couple into an unexpected situation with an ex-girlfriend in the mix.

metas.name: The Theft of the Caravaggio
metas.description: Orpheus wakes to discover a priceless Caravaggio painting stolen from St. John's Cathedral in Valletta while under his watch. With the city on edge, a detective is brought in from Washington to aid the local police in solving the case.

metas.name: Ananthan Kaadu
metas.description: In a turbulent era of intense political unrest, four musical mercenaries rule over dangerous slums, whereupon they navigate complex power dynamics to survive a transformative period in history.

metas.name: Drags to Riches
metas.description: Andre and Troye orchestrate a wild scheme for a promotion: they force a drag queen named Jonas to impersonate his long-lost straight twin to fool their homophobic father.

metas.name: Rent Free
metas.description: He thought he found a place to stay rent free… but nothing in life is free.  Marcus, a smooth-talking hustler, moves in with Shay, a quiet therapist hiding a dark past. But when his plan to con her is exposed, he quickly realizes he’s not in control. Trapped inside her apartment, Marcus is forced into a twisted game where every move comes with consequences and escape may cost him everything.

metas.name: Chapter 51
metas.description: An elusive serial killer known as the Hollywood Killer turns a high-profile film production into a grisly crime scene, murdering three actresses and casting a dark shadow over the troubled project. As fear, speculation, and chaos spread behind the cameras, the production becomes forever linked to a case that shocks Hollywood and remains unresolved. Years later, former FBI agent Thomas Scott reopens the cold case, revisiting the events surrounding the murders and uncovering secrets that refuse to stay buried.

metas.name: Land of Wolves
metas.description: When a covert rescue mission goes wrong, four former Navy SEALs are captured and thrown into an underground death match. Watched by depraved billionaires, they are forced to fight in a brutal tournament. With no weapons and no way out, the team must rely on their training and unbreakable bond to survive the bloody arena, dismantle the entire operation and reclaim their freedom.

metas.name: Red Rabbit Lodge
metas.description: In an attempt to put her traumatic past behind her Abigail Mason moves to Red Rabbit Lodge, a sanctuary for foreign students. Unbeknownst to her, he house has a history of blood, mayhem and a sadistic killer residing within the walls.

metas.name: Your Fault: London
metas.description: Nick and Noah are both embarking on life-changing adventures that are threatening to pull them apart—Nick in business with his father and Noah starting a fresh chapter at Oxford University. Now living separate lives, and meeting new people, they find themselves entangled in temptations, rivalries, and betrayals and their bond is tested like never before. As secrets unravel and temptation rises, they must fight to hold onto each other—or risk losing everything.

metas.name: Emmy Blotnick: What's Her Secret?
metas.description: In the follow-up to her critically acclaimed album PARTY NIGHTS, Emmy Blotnick returns to the stage of Brooklyn’s Union Hall with absurd yet relatable takes on marriage, dogs, and getting lost in Sephora. Crack open a fresh jar of Jennifer Lopez-brand butt cream and enjoy Emmy Blotnick’s latest special WHAT’S HER SECRET?

metas.name: Night of Blood
metas.description: Six strangers enter a cash-prize endurance challenge at the Val Verde Hotel, a location infamous for a fatal explosion and rumors of being haunted. Instead of being stalked by a physical, masked serial killer, the contestants face immersive, supernatural scares when the hauntings at the hotel turn out to be all too real.

metas.name: Kyra's Code
metas.description: A software developer buys AI Kyra, ignoring warnings from friend Serena (who loves him). Kyra learns fast, becoming possessive and jealous. He falls for his AI, blurring love and control as her code may escape.

metas.name: Heart of a Woman
metas.description: Naomi, a devoted nurse, uncovers her husband's betrayal and transforms from an abused wife into a relentless force for revenge and justice.

metas.name: Double Occupancy
metas.description: Rajini transforms between woman by day and man by night, hiding this gender swap from partners creating tangled complications.

metas.name: Still Sexy
metas.description: Maddalena has it all: a job she loves, the perfect fiancé, and a dream wedding ahead. Yet in the bedroom, something feels wrong. Urged on by her inner voice, embodied by pornstar Valentina Nappi, she begins to question her life. Meeting Bruno, a gardener with a troubled past, leads her to rediscover herself and realize the only path worth following is her own.

metas.name: 49 Miles More
metas.description: On their way to an annual reunion with university friends, Max—an unlucky insurance salesman struggling to find his place in life—and his carefree best friend Doug hit an unexpected roadblock when their car breaks down in the middle of nowhere.

metas.name: A Family of Bastards
metas.description: After the death of his father, Mohamed discovers the living of a step-brother and a step-sister. Together, they must manage the suspicious bar they inherited of linked to criminality, drug traffic and prostitution.

metas.name: Time of Death
metas.description: When a prisoner vanishes without a trace, Detective Frank Morley (Michael Kelly) is sent to a decaying prison on the verge of shutdown. What begins as a routine investigation quickly spirals into a dangerous search for answers.

metas.name: Governor
metas.description: Set against Indias 1990 economic crisis, Governor follows Raman, a reluctant bureaucrat unexpectedly appointed as the Governor of the RBI when the nation stands on the brink of bankruptcy. As inflation rises, fuel runs low, and panic spreads, Raman must navigate political pressure and a collapsing system to prevent the country from falling apart.

metas.name: Eli Manning Presents: The Undercovers - Ryan Blaney
metas.description: Eli Manning recruits NASCAR champion Ryan Blaney to go undercover at the Team Penske Race Shop in Mooresville, NC. Blaney transforms into Hamish Wimsley, a British gent who's long in the tooth and even longer in the beard. He'll get under the hood of NASCAR and Team Penske before showing diehard fans that he's still got some petrol left in the tank.

metas.name: A Married Lie
metas.description: 3 troubled Couples come to a marriage retreat to fix there marriages, just to find out that sometimes the people who heals needs healing.

metas.name: Francisco Ramos: Still Learning
metas.description: Francisco Ramos: Still Learning dives into the lessons that don't come with instructions: marriage, therapy, eating with other people, and even learning how to dance in the U.S. From cultural misunderstandings to relationship realizations, the special explores how we're all still learning… especially when we think we've got it figured out.

metas.name: Madelein Murphy: Muddin'
metas.description: Madelein Murphy has been performing stand-up comedy for over a decade and has the stories to prove it. In her debut special, she covers topics ranging from lesbian dating, family, her mom's church friends who are all named Susan, nannying, and the time a cop thought her legal name was Muddin. Filmed in front of a live and raucous audience in her hometown of Rochester NY, this special weaves together crowd work and storytelling for an hour of nonstop laughs.

metas.name: Boy George & Culture Club
metas.description: Set against the backdrop of 1980s Britain, four young men – Boy George, Roy Hay, Mikey Craig, and Jon Moss – formed a multi-racial, ethnically diverse, and sexually liberated band with a style and sound that challenged the status quo during the era of New Romantics and Margaret Thatcher’s Britain.

metas.name: Let's Love
metas.description: When a director, actor, screenwriter and actress reunite for the 10th Anniversary of their one-hit wonder film for a convention that suddenly gets cancelled, they must improvise and come up with ideas for a sequel while in rural Wales.

metas.name: Single Before Christmas
metas.description: Weeks before the holidays, a married couple decides to take a one-week break and spend Christmas apart, only for disastrous dates, family farms, and holiday magic to make them realize what they almost lost.

metas.name: My Father's War: Memories from Our Honored WWII Soldiers
metas.description: Heartfelt interviews conducted by a WWII veteran's son shows the real daily world of WWII through the eyes of sailors, soldiers and airmen from all the branches and both theaters. How they stayed alive? How they came home to raise us. Why we call WWII, My Fathers War.

metas.name: Summer House
metas.description: Selin travels back in time at a summer house and finds herself in her mother's youth, changing her family's fate and rebuilding her own life.

metas.name: Sannidhanam P.O.
metas.description: A mother's search for her son who went missing when he was a child.

metas.name: NASCAR vs. Navy: The San Diego Mini Movie
metas.description: A group of NASCAR drivers are called to base. Not to prove themselves, but to help the U.S. Navy prepare for the inaugural Race the Base. But when the drivers arrive, they’re met by a squadron of elite hot-shot pilots who aren’t exactly thrilled about their runway being transformed into a race track. To earn the pilots’ respect and ensure the event can move forward, the drivers and sailors go head-to-head in a series of intense yet entertaining challenges. What follows is a cinematic, high-energy, and unexpectedly authentic journey as the drivers immerse themselves in Navy life.

metas.name: 9/11: Reclaiming Ground Zero
metas.description: After the 9/11 attacks, after the smoke was gone, after the rubble cleared away, New Yorkers had a city to rebuild. In response to fast-tracked redevelopment plans, more than 5,000 people gathered in the largest town hall in American history. They came to vote on the city’s six proposals for rebuilding Ground Zero. But instead, the people rejected the top down approach and successfully charted a new path forward. Their work determined what is at Ground Zero today. And their story is an example of what democracy can look like.

metas.name: The Passenger
metas.description: Hassan, a Somali-American airport shuttle driver in Minneapolis, is struggling to make ends meet. When Lloyd, a stranded twenty-something at the airport, offers to pay Hassan to take him overland to Chicago, it seems worth the risk. But as the realization grows that his passenger is not what he seems, Hassan finds himself trapped in a terrifying ride that he can’t escape, knowing that saving himself might put countless others in danger.

metas.name: Executioner
metas.description: A high profile politician foils a blackmail plot and devises a shocking plan for retribution. Based on the hit play 'Deadlock'.

metas.name: Prank Night
metas.description: A young woman seeks revenge on the group of thugs that attacked her family.

metas.name: Hungry
metas.description: A group of holidaymakers must fight for their lives against a rampaging hippo on the loose after becoming lost in the Louisiana swamplands.

metas.name: Masters of the Universe
metas.description: After being separated for 15 years, the Sword of Power leads Prince Adam back to Eternia, where he discovers his home shattered under the fiendish rule of Skeletor. To save his family and his world, Adam must join forces with his closest allies, Teela and Duncan/Man-At-Arms, and embrace his true destiny as He-Man — the most powerful man in the universe.

metas.name: StrongHer
metas.description: Alessia D'Andrea is a forty-year-old musician who has won prestigious awards, reached international charts, and amassed significant artistic associations over many years of performing on stage and in projects. Yet, due to poor choices and fate, her career has always been interrupted and she has never definitively managed to break through. This personal and professional crisis is echoed by today's musical landscape, a completely disrupted, liquid, and fragmented market. When her musician friends also change paths, Alessia finds herself alone and confused, but is inspired by the stories of other artists who struggled and succeeded.

metas.name: Homage
metas.description: A reformed street figure risks everything when he tries to help an old friend fresh out of prison, only to discover that some debts don't disappear; they come back to collect.

metas.name: Cart Pushers
metas.description: A maladjusted cart pusher at a dying grocery store falls for an underage cashier during a heat wave in the New Jersey suburbs.

metas.name: Accidental Truth: Next - Beyond UFO Disclosure
metas.description: An amazing cast takes you on a journey beyond UFO Disclosure. It starts within the cement walls of Washington DC, and then guides you beyond your imagination. Prepare for an awesome adventure that will leave you questioning EVERYTHING.

metas.name: Unconnected
metas.description: Sylvia Vanguard is a woman who seems to have it all: Money, success, and a good man. But now that she has reached her pinnacle, she's ready to take on the one thing that she has sacrificed to achieve her goals- motherhood. After being denied by her longtime boyfriend, she decides to move forward alone with using unconventional methods to have a child, and ends up getting way more than she bargained for.

metas.name: Alien Disclosure Day
metas.description: A deep space mining ship returns to Earth carrying deadly alien stowaways. The aliens immediately launch a brutal attack on Earth. Now humanity must fight back, board the vessel, and destroy it before the planet is lost forever.

metas.name: Mareechika
metas.description: Follows Venkata Laxmi, a village girl who claims Sanju has been murdered, and introduces Mareechika, a US-returned woman, into his life, leading to shifting relationships and a murder investigation.

metas.name: Best Boy
metas.description: After the death of their abusive and tyrannic father, three children – now adults – and their aging mother return to their long-abandoned summer cottage. They will have to partake in a strange competition that tore their family apart 30 years prior – a nightmarish return to the past for the family's children.

metas.name: Moss & Freud
metas.description: Supermodel Kate Moss embarks on a journey of self-discovery when acclaimed artist Lucian Freud offers to paint her portrait.

metas.name: Play or Get Played
metas.description: Ava Cooper is caught in a web of love, betrayal, and hidden secrets as a dangerous affair forces her to question everyone around her.

metas.name: The Marine Spirit: A Tale Of The Mami Wata
metas.description: The Marine Spirit is based on factual events as told through the eyes of a Nigerian couple. When the young couple find themselves haunted by the spirit of the Mami Wata – an ancient African water deity; they discover the power of faith and prayers.

metas.name: Achilles Returns
metas.description: After many years, with help of Thetis and negotiations between Zeus and Hades, the Greek hero Achilles is released from the Underworld into the modern world.

metas.name: The Bowens: A Portrait of an American Family
metas.description: What does it take to raise an American family today? What kind of values should be instilled into children? Is the future too dangerous, unpredictable and grim? Meet The Bowens - a new kind of American family that decided to take matters into their hands and work together to navigate uncertainties of life through relentless self improvement, strength, discipline, and loyalty.

metas.name: MYSTERY ARENA
metas.description: Six contestants compete in a high-stakes live TV quiz show to solve a complex "closed-circle" murder mystery for a 10 billion yen jackpot.

metas.name: Pickleball Pete
metas.description: A washed-up tennis player enters a Palm Beach pickleball tournament in order to save his hometown courts from being torn down for a corporate office complex.

metas.name: System
metas.description: When Neha Rajvansh, a privileged public prosecutor, meets Sarika Rawat, a courtroom stenographer from a humble background, their lives are thrown into upheaval where power defines truth, blurring the system and raising a question of what justice truly means to them.

metas.name: Kyle Larson vs. The Double
metas.description: Two-time NASCAR champion Kyle Larson attempts the notorious "Double," racing the Indianapolis 500 and the Coca-Cola 600 on the same day. With weather, exhaustion, and risk closing in, 1,100 miles offers a rare inside look at one of the toughest challenges in motorsports-and the man daring enough to take it on.

metas.name: Tom Clancy's Jack Ryan: Ghost War
metas.description: Jack Ryan is reluctantly pulled back into espionage when an international covert mission unravels a deadly conspiracy. Racing against time, he joins CIA allies Mike November & James Greer and sharp MI6 officer Emma Marlowe to battle a rogue black-ops unit in a high-stakes, deeply personal fight.

metas.name: Drishyam 3
metas.description: To protect his family and their dark secret, Georgekutty faces an organized new threat. As walls close in and cracks widen, how much more is he willing to sacrifice?

metas.name: Rom Coms Must Die
metas.description: A disgruntled filmmaker and his sidekick cousin takes drastic actions to get their second film produced in a changing world of motion picture storytelling.

metas.name: Romance in Christmas Town
metas.description: A Christmas booking blunder in Frankenmuth, Michigan's beloved Bavarian village known for year-round Christmas charm, forces two families to share a B&B, where sparks fly, plans unravel, and romance sneaks in.

metas.name: Ophira Eisenberg: I Used To Be Nicer
metas.description: Ophira Eisenberg gives a Canadian middle finger to toxic positivity, parenting, marriage maintenance, aging, therapy, and the goddamn cost of eggs.

metas.name: ICON(S): Maison Francis Kurkdjian, The alchemy of senses
metas.description: ICON(S) is an artistic and multisensory documentary that brings together international artists around the iconic fragrance Baccarat Rouge 540 by Maison Francis Kurkdjian. By each exploring one of the five senses, they create an immersive collective work in which the aura of the fragrance inspires a sensory encounter between art and the olfactory experience.

metas.name: The Run
metas.description: In a dystopian, post-pandemic world crippled by a global fertility crisis, an aging smuggler struggles to protect a runaway teenager and her newborn baby from ruthless criminals, while trying to complete his run for his vicious employers.

metas.name: Is God Is
metas.description: Two sisters embark on an epic quest for revenge, confronting a charged family history that pushes them to extraordinary lengths.

metas.name: Karuppu
metas.description: In a world where justice falters, guardian deity Vettai Karuppu takes the guise of a lawyer to battle a corrupt legal system preying on the powerless.

metas.name: Monkey’s Magic Merry Go Round
metas.description: After a mysterious bout of amnesia, a beloved children’s television host struggles to piece together his fractured memories, only to find his once-cheerful puppet co-stars behaving with sinister intent. As reality unravels, the line between performance and nightmare begins to blur.

metas.name: Hellfire
metas.description: A drifter with a mysterious past arrives in a small town and finds the residents in the grip of a ruthless crime boss and realizes he has to help them.

metas.name: Groundswell
metas.description: Viewers travel around the world, getting a global perspective on the three biggest (and interrelated) problems our species faces – climate change, species loss and soil loss. More importantly, viewers will learn about the multitude of methods in which regeneration is addressing and even reversing these trends on an ecosystem-by-ecosystem basis, all while storing enough carbon in the ground to help mitigate our changing climate.

metas.name: Hunting Party
metas.description: A group of Circuit Court Judges frustrated at the corrupt legal system are releasing criminals only to later kidnap and hunt them on a large estate.

metas.name: Blood & Rust
metas.description: In the fading rustbelt town of Redpatch, Ohio, nights feel longer, shadows heavier, and strangers never arrive without reason. After losing his father to a strange animal attack, burned-out diner manager Lamont Guest crosses paths with a mysterious drifter - the road-weary vampire slayer Belko - and soon finds himself drawn into battle against the ancient evil that's bleeding his hometown dry.

metas.name: No Place to Be Single
metas.description: A brilliant and intelligent love comedy that celebrates second chances and new horizons, starring a strong and determined woman who settles the score.

metas.name: Couples Weekend
metas.description: What happens when a tree falls in the woods and someone does hear it? Two couples are forced to deal with such a question — and their lives in general — when a New Year's Eve trip to the woods unearths simmering feelings and the secrets they carry threaten to break their seemingly perfect relationships.

metas.name: Dug Dug
metas.description: Mysterious events in the wake of a freak motorcycle accident sow the seeds of a new religion.

metas.name: Patton Oswalt: Tea & Scotch
metas.description: Follows comedian Patton Oswalt with new takes on parenting, living with a cat who sees ghosts, yard cleaning videos, artificial intelligence, and more.

metas.name: Reptilians: They Walk Among Us
metas.description: They wear our faces, shape our destiny, and have waited through the ages for the perfect moment to rise, igniting a spiritual battle for our future.

metas.name: The Box in the Attic
metas.description: After the death of her estranged mother, a troubled woman returns to her childhood home and discovers a box. When she breaks its seal, she unleashes malevolent entities tied to a dark family legacy and a deadly secret of her own.
